units.caption: Supplementary Fig. 24 | Temporal, basin and environmental support of the single main sample. a, Unique main-sample SIDs by genesis year (1982–2023; 42 years; N=2,340). Complete retained lifetimes and existing follow-up may extend beyond the genesis year. b, Genesis-month percentages within each genesis basin. c, Basin fractions within each genesis year. d, Number of main-sample cyclones with a valid stage-level environmental exposure, separately for each variable and stage; shading denotes percentage of the 2,340 main-sample SIDs. D, Development; E, Intensification; F, near-peak persistence; Res, Resolution. Each environmental diagnostic retains its valid subset of the main sample. These are observed counts and descriptive distributions, so no sampling intervals are shown.
